headline: Uzbekistan Airways takes delivery of its sixth Airbus A321neo with a new cabin (photo)
summary: Uzbekistan Airways received its sixth Airbus A321neo LR aircraft, which flew directly from the manufacturer's plant in Hamburg. The aircraft features a revamped cabin and business-class flat-bed seats.
why: Airbus is a major commercial aircraft manufacturer, and airline fleet deliveries drive its order backlog and revenue. Airlines' fleet expansions also reflect regional aviation demand.
original_headline: Uzbekistan Airways yangicha salonli oltinchi Airbus A321neo samolyotini qabul qilib oldi (foto)
